# RC50 — Direct dirty-buffer navigation

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc w ]` / `workspace.next-dirty-buffer` / `Next Dirty Buffer`.
- Added `Esc w [` / `workspace.previous-dirty-buffer` / `Previous Dirty Buffer`.
- Dirty-buffer navigation cycles only through modified buffers, skips clean buffers, wraps in buffer order, and reports clean-workspace or only-current-dirty states in the footer.
- Updated the WORKSPACE action-layer hint to expose dirty-buffer navigation.
- The README namespace table and iPad QA matrix now cover direct dirty-buffer triage.
